title: オークスの後に・最後のティアラヘ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon stuns the crowd with a breathtaking run. Slowly but surely, people are beginning to recognize her for her skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, there's no doubt Narita Brian will win the second crown, and Hishi Amazon can't afford to fall behind. Our next challenge will be the Shuka Sho!
